# Context Fabric

> Connected context that supports work across people, domains, and agents.

Start with a task in the entry guide. For existing context, use the named view's
instruction and the practitioner's Individual document; this index is not an
additional task-time reading requirement.

- [Start here](START-HERE.md): assisted tasks, existing-view reuse and local skill access.
- [Use cases](docs/marketing/use-cases.md): individual, team and organizational starting points.
- [Tool routes](docs/tool-routes.md): route choices, checkout and bundle setup, bindings and tool requirements.
- [Review and rehearsal](docs/review-and-rehearsal.md): owner review, colleague entry point and revision-specific acceptance.
- [Repository agent routing](AGENTS.md): maintainer versus product-work entry.
- [Authoring](docs/authoring.md): field meanings, evidence and limitation levels.
- [Maintenance interface](docs/maintenance-interface.md): agent reference for scripts and operations.
- [Secret references](docs/secret-references.md): bounded credential handling.
- [Experiments](docs/experiments/README.md): observations, limits and pending tests.
- [Contributing](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md): spec-driven framework changes and verification.
- [Org template](templates/org.TEMPLATE.yaml): draft shared systems and interfaces.
- [Bounded Context template](templates/bounded-context.TEMPLATE.yaml): draft a working set.
- [Individual template](templates/individual.TEMPLATE.yaml): private local bindings.
- [Org development skill](.agents/skills/develop-org/SKILL.md): search before authoring.
- [Bounded Context skill](.agents/skills/develop-bounded-context/SKILL.md): extend shared facts.
- [Individual setup skill](.agents/skills/setup-individual/SKILL.md): machine and solo setup.
- [Validation skill](.agents/skills/validate-and-generate/SKILL.md): checks, views and releases.
